review.selectedRoute: Use the existing full literal coset formula and native coefficient-map cocycles. Linearity commutes the coefficient endomorphism with the finite sum, and the existing H1 projection formula descends both orders. Apply the already audited geometric cohomology equality. This is shorter than new tensor decompositions or a second trace-naturality framework.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: The H1 operator with any prescribed coefficient endomorphism equals the ordinary constant-coefficient correspondence followed by that endomorphism on H1, and also equals the reverse composition. This includes exactly the original homogeneous diagonal matrix action and does not remove it.
review.remaining: An arithmetic Picard/H1 comparison must realize the ordinary correspondence and retain this explicit coefficient factor. Full/parabolic and diamond conventions, arithmetic finite-character realization, original all-weight characteristic-zero association, local/image/regularity, automorphy and higher continuation remain open. No character lift follows merely from this factorization. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
